description: This Java class represents a command for sending a message to a specific feature of a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It supports serialization/deserialization, validation of feature IDs, and provides factory methods for creating instances, both from parameters and from JSON representations.

classes.name: SendFeatureMessage
classes.description: A command class to send a message to a specific feature of a Thing, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature targeted by this message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for this message, returning a new instance.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the payload information to a JSON object builder during serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for this message object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering featureId and superclass fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals to verify object compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
